messages:
Ravi: Spun up azalea-v2 q8 smoke and seeing consistent CJK<->RTL spacing drop compared to fp16.
Mei: Example?
Ravi: INPUT: "今日は السلام world"
FP16: "今日は السلام world"
Q8: "今日はالسلام world"  <-- missing separator between CJK and Arabic
Omar: Token ids match on quick diff. Looks like detok applied generic join. Any detok logs?
Ravi: Logs show: 
- tokenizer: v2 loaded
- quant init: q8 ok
- detok: profile load failed (path not found) -> fallback generic
Jules: That sounds like path resolution / working-dir mismatch on quant runtime. We saw this with other models.
Mei: Can we short-circuit by bundling locale profile into artifact or resolve absolute path at startup?
Omar: Agreed. Quick fix: change loader to prefer absolute env var REDWOOD_LOCALE_PROFILE; fallback to packaged copy. I'll open PR.
Ravi: Also adding a bringup smoke: run 1k mixed-orient samples and assert "separator rate" within 97% of fp16 baseline.
ci-bot: Job queued: ci/azalea-detok-smoke/1820000000 #1200
Jules: Hold wide rollout until smoke passes. Patch in review.
Ravi: Filed ticket ML-3602 with failing sample ids. Will post CI when done.
